world.title: Britain sends Typhoon fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthis, rules out offensive strikes
world.summary: Britain is enhancing its military support for Saudi Arabia by deploying RAF Typhoon fighter jets for defensive air patrols against Yemen's Houthi rebels. Additionally, the UK will extend its air-to-air refuelling mission for another 90 days. However, British officials have confirmed that there will be no offensive strikes as part of this military assistance.

world.title: Does Trump’s 60-day tariff waiver really give relief to India? What it means for US trade deal & oil prices
world.summary: US President Donald Trump has issued a 60-day waiver on tariffs for countries purchasing oil from Russia, invoking Section 115 of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026. This decision raises questions about its implications for India, particularly regarding trade relations and potential impacts on oil prices amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

world.title: Reform Or Regime Change? What Global Movements Tell Us About Protest Goals
world.summary: The Global Protest Tracker reports that over the past year, significant protests occurred in more than 57 countries. However, only seven of these protests, representing 12%, aimed for regime change. This data highlights the diverse goals of global movements, suggesting that while many protests seek reform, only a small fraction pursue the overthrow of existing governments.

business.title: Bajaj Finance vs IREDA vs Reliance's Jio Financial: Top financial stock to buy after Q2 results 2026 for best returns?
business.summary: Bajaj Finance and IREDA announced their Q2 results for September 2026 on October 19, 2026. Analysts are evaluating these results alongside Reliance's Jio Financial to determine which financial stock offers the best potential returns. The analysis considers performance metrics and market conditions, aiming to guide investors in making informed decisions based on the latest financial data.

business.title: $800 million asset manager to shift 2 funds out of GIFT on tax issues
business.summary: Artha Bharat Investment Managers, an $800 million asset manager, is relocating two funds from GIFT to Abu Dhabi Global Market. The decision is driven by uncertainties regarding tax deductions, compliance requirements, and investor restrictions. This move aims to enhance operational efficiency and address the challenges posed by the current regulatory environment affecting the funds' management and investor engagement.

business.title: SBI data breach claim: Hacker group alleges access to 3.75 lakh records, 2,722 documents
business.summary: A hacker group named Siriusim claims to have accessed 375,000 customer records and 2,722 loan documents linked to the State Bank of India (SBI), according to cybersecurity account CyberPulse56. The authenticity and extent of this alleged data breach have not been verified. SBI has yet to comment on the claims made by the hacker group.

technology.title: Spotify Cracks Down on Family Plans With QR Code Checks
technology.summary: Spotify is implementing QR code checks for its Premium Family plan to ensure members reside at the same address. Subscribers must scan a QR code in person to verify their residence. Failure to complete this verification within a seven-day deadline may result in losing access to the Premium plan and facing a 12-month ban from rejoining.

technology.title: SpaceX's Starfall capsule heads to orbit for the second time
technology.summary: SpaceX launched its Starfall return capsule for the second time during the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. The capsule aims to provide affordable access to microgravity for research and manufacturing. According to a Federal Aviation Administration environmental assessment, Starfall measures 2.5 feet in height and 10.2 feet in width, featuring a disk-shaped design.

technology.title: Amazon Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse: Price, Features and AI Functions
technology.summary: Amazon launched two AI devices, Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse, on October 15, 2026. Bee Frontier is priced at $74.99, while Bee Eclipse costs $99.99. Both devices utilize AI technology to summarize conversations, create reminders, and organize tasks. The announcement included details on features, subscription options, and privacy controls for users interested in these products.

sports.title: Asian Para Games 2026 Live, Oct 20: Nishad dominates high jump, India sweep men's discus throw final
sports.summary: India excelled on Day 2 of the Asian Para Games 2026, securing multiple medals. Nishad Kumar won gold in the men's high jump T47, setting a new record at 2.04m. Deepthi Jeevanji claimed gold in the women's 400m T20, while Indian shooters earned two medals in javelin F53/54, and Bhavina Patel added a bronze in para table tennis.

sports.title: Former PSG star opens up on failed move to Barcelona – ‘I don’t regret it at all’
sports.summary: Former PSG player Mohamed Sissoko shared his thoughts ahead of the upcoming match between Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain. He expressed excitement for the encounter, highlighting the strength of both teams. Sissoko also discussed his previous failed transfer to Barcelona, stating that he does not regret the situation at all. The match is anticipated to be a thrilling competition.

sports.title: All-round Gardner seals Rose Bowl for Australia
sports.summary: Australia's allrounder Gardner scored 84 runs off 45 balls and took two wickets, leading her team to a 40-run victory over New Zealand in the Rose Bowl match. Australia posted a total of 167 for 7, with Mooney contributing 39 runs. New Zealand's Nensi and J Kerr each took two wickets but couldn't secure a win.

health.title: Low daily step count linked to dementia and stroke risks. It’s time to put your trusty phone in charge
health.summary: A study found that individuals with low daily step counts are at higher risk for obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and depression compared to more active individuals. The research analyzed activity data from thousands of users over a year, highlighting the challenges of maintaining physical activity in modern life. This trend is linked to increasing rates of dementia and stroke.

health.title: Not all ultra-processed foods show the same cancer risk
health.summary: A major US study indicates that not all ultra-processed foods are linked to the same colorectal cancer risks. It emphasizes the importance of examining specific dietary components, such as whole grains, fiber, dairy, and processed meats, rather than relying solely on food-processing labels. This highlights the need for more detailed research on diet quality and cancer risk factors.

science.title: Scientists make discovery that could help explain why life exists: Study
science.summary: Scientists have made a discovery that may clarify conditions necessary for life in the universe. They propose a scenario where stars shine and planets form, but thick liquids hinder cellular functions. This research suggests that even with essential chemical ingredients, life may struggle to exist under certain conditions, highlighting the complexity of life's requirements in various environments.

science.title: Two eyes on the Sun: How India’s Aditya-L1 and Europe’s Proba-3 studied solar eruptions together
science.summary: India's Aditya-L1 and Europe's Proba-3 missions collaborated to study solar eruptions, enhancing their observational capabilities. Although distinct missions, their instruments work together to analyze the Sun's outer atmosphere, which experiences violent eruptions that release significant material into space. This joint effort aims to improve understanding of solar activity and its effects on space weather and Earth.

science.title: Four crew members spent 365 days in a 1,700 sq ft, 3D-printed Mars habitat in isolation. How could it help NASA prepare for living on the Moon?
science.summary: NASA's CHAPEA mission simulates living on Mars with four crew members isolated for 365 days in a 1,700 sq ft habitat. The study examines human management of isolation and limited resources during extended missions. Findings will inform future lunar habitat design and functionality. Participants will undergo health and performance evaluations post-mission to aid NASA's preparations for sustained Moon activity.

entertainment.title: Prince William calls Karan Johar an ‘icon’, promises to watch Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham after meeting filmmaker in London
entertainment.summary: Prince William met filmmaker Karan Johar during an Earthshot Prize event, an environmental initiative he founded. He praised Johar as an "icon" and expressed his intention to watch the Bollywood film "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham." Johar has been instrumental in enhancing the project's visibility in India, contributing to its global outreach efforts.

entertainment.title: Deepika Padukone And Ranveer Singh Reveal Name Of Their Second Daughter On Dussehra, Share First Glimpse Of Newborn
entertainment.summary: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh announced the name of their second daughter, Devi Padukone Singh, during Dussehra celebrations. The couple shared their first family photograph since the birth of their child, who was welcomed on September 19, 2026. The announcement highlights their joy as they introduce their newborn to the public for the first time.

entertainment.title: Deepika Padukone, Ranveer Singh announce second baby's name as Devi Padukone Singh, drop FIRST glimpse in a family portrait on Dussehra, Dua kisses her baby sister - PIC inside
entertainment.summary: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh welcomed their second child, a baby girl, on September 19, coinciding with Radhashtami. On Dussehra, they announced her name as Devi Padukone Singh. The couple shared a family portrait featuring their elder daughter, Dua, kissing her baby sister. This announcement marks a joyful moment for the family as they celebrate their new addition.
